name: analyticom-player-photo
description: Download original Analyticom player photos using saved ClubATX player-to-athlete links.

interface.longDescription: Download the original Analyticom player photo from the saved ClubATX athlete link. Resolves the exact athlete slug through analyticom_player_links, retrieves its player picture, and saves a local image without updating athlete records. Requires local Supabase and Analyticom credentials.
defaultPrompt: Download the Analyticom photo for this linked ClubATX athlete
